# Marianne Dawson

> Software developer, writer, and founder of Klew Studio. Builds tools for AI-human collaboration, including threadlinking (an npm package and MCP server for preserving decision-making context across AI sessions). Writes about computational semiotics, analytical frameworks, and AI tooling.

Marianne's work sits at the intersection of software engineering, narrative design, and AI augmentation. She builds systems that help humans and AI agents collaborate more effectively by preserving context, structuring intent, and making decisions traceable.

## Projects

- [Threadlinking](https://github.com/thrialectics/threadlinking): CLI tool and MCP server for preserving decision-making context across AI coding sessions. Published on npm.
- [Klew Studio](https://klew.studio): Narrative strategy studio designing ARGs and immersive experiences
- [Serpent/Dove (Bye, Marianne)](https://byemarianne.com): Multi-platform alternate reality game with cryptographic identity layer
- [Intention Primitive Language](https://apo-pitch.netlify.app/): Research prototype for a declarative language describing software intentions
